en.description:
In 2016 a big smart contract had a flaw, and someone drained sixty million dollars from it without breaking anything: he just read the contract better than they did. en.title: A Smart Contract Is a Vending Machine 🥤 #Shorts
en.description:
In 2013 a nineteen-year-old asked: why should this ledger only record money? Let it run programs. In 2015 Ethereum went live. A smart contract is a vending machine: put in the coin, the machine checks the condition, and the item drops by itself. No seller, and no one can go back on the deal.
